tasks.task: Check product facts for failed checks
Check catalogue policy for listing readiness rules
Compare MCP listing with product facts and catalogue policy

acceptance_criteria: Base readiness on readiness_checks and failed_checks in product_facts.
Cite catalogue_policy as the source of the readiness rules.
Name every failed check as a fix, or state that none failed.
constraints: product_facts is authoritative for stored product fields and rule results.
mcp_listing is an independent cross-check; it does not define catalogue policy.
Do not invent prices, stock, sales or competitor data.
Do not edit, publish, archive or delete the product.

result.recommendation: The product listing for SKU-COM-2004 is ready to publish under the catalogue policy as there are no failed checks in product_facts.
result.rationale: product_facts indicates that all required criteria (active status, valid category, and description length) have been met, aligning with the Listing Readiness section of the shared-rag-product-catalogue-policy.md policy. No failed checks necessitate any fixes as per the catalogue_policy content provided in product_facts.

recommendations: Check the catalogue policy for listing readiness rules and ensure that all required criteria are met. Review the product facts to confirm that there are no new,
